result.training_type: Finite source-program consistency induction and target version-space filtering; no neural training.
result.interpretation: Tests transfer and calibration of source-consistent feedback bindings. Compare with the fixed full-state-and-clock baseline before drawing any method-advantage conclusion.
result.limitations: A researcher-supplied classical flow-continuation template and finite grammar, deterministic noise-free fixtures, one source law, four selected target laws, three parameter cases each. No recovered law, official discovery score, reward task or independent benchmark success rate.

headline_cn: 原生反馈程序学习与迁移已跑通，但完整状态与时钟的固定基线同样全部通过，且省去学习成本；尚无新方法优势。
report_note_cn: 完成一个原生 DiscoverPhysics 反馈程序原型：在预先给定的续接模板与 32 种字段绑定中，用 gravity 的 66 次实际调用保留 2 个源数据无法区分的程序；二者都传递中间位置和速度，区别是是否推进绝对时钟。迁移到 yukawa、coulomb_easy、extra_dimensions、oscillator，每个目标用 1 个校准条件、3 次调用选择变体，再检查 3 个预先固定的后续条件。冻结的省略时钟变体在前三类各通过 3/3，在 oscillator 为 0/3；保留歧义后校准的程序四类均通过 3/3。然而完整传递状态和时钟的固定基线也四类全部通过，并且不需要源学习或目标校准，因此不能声称新的方法收益。全部 126 次原生调用在 CPU 上耗时约 22.2 秒，无模型 API 或 GPU。这里测量的是续接一致性，不是规律发现成功率；模板和字段语法由研究者提供。原生 oscillator 已提供 start_time，不能把遗漏时钟后的差异说成隐藏状态或耗散机制。
next_requirement: Require an implemented learning operation whose resulting experimental program structure and core-task utility improve over same-data model-based experiment generation and applicable fixed controls. Binding selection in the supplied continuation template is exhausted by the fixed complete-state-and-clock baseline. Do not scale this family or infer discovery success from identity checks. Compare computational and environment-interaction costs separately; an exact planning oracle is an upper-bound comparator, not a baseline that must be beaten in its own expected-utility objective.
researcher_supplied: Binary field-binding grammar including optional start_time

closest_priors.finding: Maintaining and refining sets of programs consistent with examples is established program version-space learning.
Relational program synthesis already synthesizes programs to satisfy relational specifications using relational version-space learning.
